title: TV Programmes

instructions.pb-6: 6. Listen to the following sounds and words, then repeat them.
instructions.wb-7: 7. Rewrite the following sentences using capital letters and full stops.

printed.pb-1-block: What time does the football match start? It starts at half past two. Let’s watch it together. I don’t like football. I prefer cartoons. They start at quarter to four. Does the quiz show start at three o’clock? No, it doesn’t. It starts at five o’clock. I love films. There is a good film tonight. It starts at quarter past six. The cooking programme starts at ten o’clock in the morning.
printed.pb-2-block: It’s quarter past five. It’s half past five. It’s quarter to six. It’s six o’clock.
printed.pb-3-block: Three numbered rows of two clock pictures, each with one tick circle. The recording determines the ticks.
printed.pb-4-block: What time is it? It is quarter past five.
printed.pb-5-block: What ’s your favourite TV programme? What time does it start? My favourite TV programme is animals programme . It starts at quarter past three.
